headlines.title: Trump claims U.S. adults will get a $5k ‘dividend’ if Republicans win the midterms
headlines.description: During his speech at the Republican midterm convention, President Donald Trump announced that every adult U.S. citizen would receive a $5,000 “dividend” if Republican won the midterm elections in November, but said it must be spent in the U.S.

headlines.title: Helena Foulkes wins Rhode Island Democratic governor primary, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee has lost his Democratic primary to former CVS executive Helena Foulkes, NBC News projects, after facing a significant spending disadvantage and voter discontent with his tenure. NBC News' Steve Kornacki breaks down the numbers.

headlines.title: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold leaves game with a hip injury
headlines.description: Darnold threw for 4,048 yards and 25 touchdowns last season while leading Seattle to the Super Bowl.

headlines.title: Everything to know about your favorite team this NFL season
headlines.description: NFL Kickoff Guide, powered by NBC Sports breaks down the most important stats, storylines and changes to know for all 32 teams heading into the 2026 season.

headlines.title: Kevin Reddington: Lindsay Clancy wants her babies
headlines.description: In his sit-down interview with NBC News’ Laura Jarrett, Kevin Reddington, the defense attorney for Lindsay Clancy, says the woman who's living amongst us is the person that everybody loved and “the person that committed this atrocious act was as a result of postpartum psychosis combined with the medications that she was provided.”

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Emergency slide accidentally deploys on Qatari-gifted Air Force One, delaying Trump
headlines.description: The incident occurred on the Qatari-donated jet as President Donald Trump was about to fly to Dallas for the GOP midterm convention.

headlines.title: ‘I’m on the ballot’: Trump tries to energize his base by placing himself front and center
headlines.description: President Donald Trump spoke on the first night of the GOP midterm convention, where he promised — without specifics — that Americans would get dividend checks if Republicans keep Congress.

headlines.title: Trump says the war in Iran will end after Election Day
headlines.description: During his speech at the Republicans’ midterm convention, President Donald Trump reinforced his commitment to ensuring Iran doesn’t possess a nuclear weapon.

headlines.title: Bernie Sanders-endorsed challenger defeats Providence mayor in a Democratic primary
headlines.description: State Rep. David Morales won the Democratic nomination for mayor of Rhode Island’s largest city over incumbent Brett Smiley, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee loses Democratic primary to businesswoman Helena Foulkes
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Foulkes won the Democratic nomination in the blue state, making McKee the first governor to fall in a primary in eight years.
